name: tinycast
description: A native macOS launcher for everyday productivity. Lightweight and open source.
readmeHtml:
Tinycast

A tiny, fully native macOS launcher. One hotkey, everything you reach for all day, under 100 MB of RAM.

SwiftUI and AppKit, zero third-party dependencies, no Electron and no telemetry. It also runs real Raycast extensions, rendered as native SwiftUI. Free, open source, and staying that way.

For anything private, email iabueammar@gmail.com.

Features

  • App launcher — fuzzy-search and launch anything, pin favorites, see what's running, quit an app or every app at once.
  • Global hotkey — one shortcut summons the palette from anywhere.
  • Per-app hotkeys — bind a key to an app; press it to toggle (focus/hide).
  • Deeplinks — run any command, window action, quicklink, snippet, note or chat from a tinycast:// URL, for Karabiner-Elements, Shortcuts or scripts. A link can carry text and arguments, and a link from outside asks before it acts. Copy Deeplink (⇧⌘C) gives you the link.
  • Search Files — find files and folders instantly from a private index of the folders you choose, kept on your Mac. Needs Full Disk Access; off by default.
  • Dictionary — look a word up with the Define Word command, or define whatever you typed from the launcher's fallbacks, read from the Mac's own dictionaries.
  • Clipboard history — text and images, searchable, pasted back into the app you were using.
  • Calculator — do math, unit, live currency and crypto conversions inline, right in the palette.
  • Quicklinks — turn a URL, search, file or deeplink into a command, with placeholders for typed input, the clipboard or the date.
  • Apple Shortcuts — search and run the shortcuts you built in the Shortcuts app, with aliases and global hotkeys.
  • Snippets — reusable Markdown templates with dynamic placeholders, arguments, nested references and optional keyword expansion.
  • Custom commands — run named shell commands through fuzzy search or their own global hotkeys.
  • Window management — 39 Rectangle-style actions: halves, quarters, thirds, sizing, nudging, edge moves, display moves, fullscreen and Spaces.
  • System actions — lock, sleep, restart, empty trash, toggle appearance, Bluetooth, mute, hidden files, and more.
  • Calendar and meetings — your next meeting on the empty palette and in the menu bar, one key to join it, or let it join itself.
  • Notes — an unlimited collection of plain Markdown files in one floating editor, searchable from the palette and rendered as you write.
  • Emoji picker — a searchable emoji grid, one keystroke away.
  • AI chat — use your own key or an installed AI account: ask Quick AI from the palette, or keep longer conversations in the AI Chat window, with a searchable, pinnable history. Off out of the box, like every AI feature.
  • Quick Actions — fix grammar, rewrite, translate or summarize the selected text in any app.
  • Dictation — press a shortcut and speak, and the text lands in the app you're using. Speech is turned into text on your Mac. Off by default.
  • Raycast extensions — run the ones you already have natively, rendered as SwiftUI.
  • Backup and import — export your settings to a file, or import your setup from Raycast.

Install

On an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or newer:

brew install --cask tinycast
  • Early builds: brew install --cask tinycast@beta installs Tinycast Beta.app beside the stable app.
  • DMG: notarized, download from Releases. Drag Tinycast.app to /Applications.
  • Intel Mac: install from our Homebrew tap.

Building from source

See docs/development.md for the toolchain, build, packaging, release and website workflows. docs/ indexes everything else — architecture, engineering standards, the design system and one document per feature.

Support

Tinycast is free, and it stays that way. If it earns a place on your Mac, consider supporting its development. Thanks in advance.


Payments are handled securely by Polar.sh.

You can also support Tinycast with crypto: scan a code with your wallet, or copy an address. Send only on the network named for that address. If yours isn't listed, email me.

releases.name: Tinycast 0.12.8
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix clipboard batch trimming and stale file previews by @abue-ammar in #1677
* Improve onboarding completion and initial language selection by @Risengan in #1671
* Clear the running dot as soon as an app quits by @abue-ammar in #1678
* Keep web OAuth state through the redirect page; update @raycast/api to 2.8.2 by @abue-ammar in #1679
* Add custom request headers to AI API connections by @abue-ammar in #1680
* Keep Volume Up/Down moving on devices that store a level off the grid by @abue-ammar in #1681
* Offer a minimized window whose subrole reads AXDialog by @isjiajia01 in #1670
* Match translation pairs against the installed locale by @HernandoR in #1665
* Resolve localized resources through the bundle's table cache by @abue-ammar in #1686
* Keep the onboarding test's palette fixture off screen by @abue-ammar in #1687
* Open the launcher on launch and report a finished update by @abue-ammar in #1688
* Add optional start and stop sounds for Dictation by @kruteev in #1690
* Open calendar events in the default calendar app by @list-jonas in #1689
* Add a Show animations toggle to General settings by @abue-ammar in #1692
* Send Apple Intelligence chats no instruc

releases.name: Tinycast Beta 0.12.7-beta.131
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Add move-to-edge window commands by @abue-ammar in #1781
* Record HTML-only and RTF-only copies in clipboard history by @abue-ammar in #1787
* Stop the exit-127 hint overlapping the command output footer by @abue-ammar in #1788

<!-- tinycast:install -->

**Channel:** beta · **Version:** 0.12.7-beta.131 · **Bundle ID:** `com.tinycast.app.beta`
Built from b75aa5a1da49d0b198ebcf87909e41fae982bab7. [Full changelog](https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/compare/v0.12.6-beta.130...v0.12.7-beta.131)

**Recommended:** install via Homebrew — it clears the quarantine flag automatically on every install and update, so there's nothing to run by hand:
```sh
brew trust --tap abue-ammar/tinycast
brew install --cask abue-ammar/tinycast/tinycast@beta
```
This build is self-signed. If you download the DMG directly instead of using Homebrew, macOS will refuse to open it until you clear the quarantine flag once:
```sh
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Tinycast Beta.app"
```

aiSummary.oneLiner: A highly efficient, fully native macOS launcher optimized for low memory usage.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Tinycast is a fully native macOS launcher designed to be incredibly resource-efficient. It provides quick access to frequently used applications and tools via a single hotkey. The application maintains a minimal footprint, consuming under 100 MB of RAM while running in the background. Built specifically for macOS 26 or later, it leverages native APIs for maximum performance and responsiveness. This makes it an ideal alternative to heavier launcher tools for users who prioritize system efficiency.
keyFeatures: Native macOS application: built directly for the platform ensuring tight integration.
Single hotkey activation: provides instant access to core functionality with one keystroke.
Low memory footprint: operates consistently while consuming less than 100 MB of RAM.
Swift 6.0 codebase: utilizes modern Swift features for safety and performance.
Open source licensing: distributed under the AGPL-3.0 license for community inspection.

useCases.title: Launch applications quickly
useCases.description: Open everyday tools instantly without navigating through menus or the Dock.

useCases.title: Conserve system resources
useCases.description: Replace resource-heavy launchers on older or memory-constrained Mac hardware.

useCases.title: Access daily tools
useCases.description: Keep the most frequently used workflows just one hotkey away throughout the day.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Mac power users and developers seeking a lightning-fast, minimal resource alternative to traditional application launchers. Perfect for those running modern macOS who want immediate access to tools without system bloat.
